subject: Re: Payment notice and remittance - clarification requested
body:
From: Emma Clarke <emmac@acme-corp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Payment notice and remittance for Nov 1 payment

Hi Sean,

We made a payment today of USD 125,430 via our virtual collection account to the Redwood virtual account ending in 2246. The remittance from our bank is attached (remittance_20271101.pdf). The payment was intended to cover the following invoices: INV-5482 (USD 82,400) and INV-5483 (USD 43,030).

Our treasury team indicated the bank sweep may have split funds across the merchant ledger during nightly processing — if you see any unapplied balance please let us know and we'll provide the MT103.

Thanks,
Emma Clarke
Head of AR | Acme Corp

--

---- Forwarded message ----
From: Acme Treasury <treasury@acme-corp.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emmac@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 08:55:00 -0500
Subject: Remittance pdf attached

Attached the remittance stub as requested.


========================

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clarke <emmac@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Payment notice and remittance for Nov 1 payment

Emma — thanks for the heads up and for sending the stub. A couple quick asks so we can reconcile this straight away: 

- Can you confirm the bank reference / trace number (MT103) for the USD 125,430 transfer? If possible please attach the MT103 (or SWIFT PDF).
- Please confirm whether the sweep split a single collect event across multiple internal accounts (we've seen virtual-account sweeps that split by currency or by invoice batch). If so, can you share the CSV mapping from your bank that shows the beneficiary references?
- Do you have VAT breakdowns for the invoices (INV-5482 / INV-5483)? Acme is in scope for EU VAT reverse charge for some SKUs and we want to tag the ledger correctly before auto-apply.

We saw an auto-apply event earlier this morning that matched a portion of the payment to an older invoice (INV-5401) — that left an unapplied balance on your virtual account. If you can supply the MT103 and the bank CSV, we'll hold manual allocation until we confirm the intended invoice mapping.

If you can get those items by EOD tomorrow (Nov 2) we'll aim to complete allocation and provide a statement of account showing the final postings.

Appreciate it —
Sean Gallagher
Director, Collections | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0148


On Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:46:00 -0500, Acme Treasury <treasury@acme-corp.com> wrote:

> From: Acme Treasury <treasury@acme-corp.com>
> To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
> Cc: Emma Clarke <emmac@acme-corp.com>
> Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:46:00 -0500
> Subject: Re: Payment notice and remittance for Nov 1 payment
>
> Hi Sean — attached: mt103_swift_111.pdf and bank_remit_mapping.csv. The CSV shows the sweep split: 100,000 USD to Redwood COLLECTION-2246 and 25,430 USD to Redwood COLLECTION-EUR (converted earlier in the day).
>
> The bank reference in MT103 is 20271101ACME2246.
>
> Notes:
> - INV-5482 was fully intended to be paid (82,400 USD).
> - INV-5483 was intended to be partially paid (40,030 USD) with the remainder 3,000 USD covering a VAT reversal charge applied by our AP team.
> - The 25,430 USD that was swept to COLLECTION-EUR relates to a currency netting process; bank provided no invoice-level reference for that portion.
>
> We'll need Redwood to indicate how the 25,430 USD is being treated for VAT and whether it will be held as unapplied until we can provide more invoice references.
>
> Thanks,
> Acme Treasury
> 

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Treasury <treasury@acme-corp.com>, Emma Clarke <emmac@acme-corp.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 16:45:00 -05:00
Subject: RE: Payment notice and remittance for Nov 1 payment

Hi Emma / Acme Treasury — appreciate the fast follow and for sending the MT103 + CSV. Internal note: we've confirmed there was an auto-apply that matched USD 100,000 to INV-5401; the remaining USD 25,430 is sitting as an unapplied credit on Acme's virtual account.

Action plan (next 48 hours):
1) Redwood Finance (cc'd) will NOT run an automated reapply overnight. We will perform a manual allocation on Thursday morning (Nov 4) after the team has reviewed the MT103 and CSV.
2) Acme — please confirm whether the 25,430 USD sweep is intended to be allocated to INV-5483 (remainder 3,000 plus 22,430) or if it should be held as a multi-invoice unapplied amount until you supply invoice refs. If you plan to allocate to INV-5483, please provide the invoice-level mapping in the CSV and indicate VAT breakdown per line.
3) Karthik / Redwood Finance: review VAT treatment. If the 25,430 USD is a currency netting adjustment, confirm whether EU VAT reverse charge applies or if this is a non-taxable FX adjustment. Provide recommended posting code (VAT_EXEMPT | VAT_RECLAIM) and confirm how that affects the customer statement.

Deliverables:
- We will send a reconciled statement of account (PDF) showing final invoice postings and the unapplied credit handling by EOD Nov 4.
- If any quick-credit reversals are needed we will propose journal entries and required supporting docs.

Emma — once you confirm intent for the 25,430 USD we'll proceed. If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-minute call Thursday morning to run through the CSV live.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 650 555 1299
